scenes.narration: What if learning Computer Networks felt like playing your favourite game?

This is NetMastery — an entire Computer Networks course rebuilt as an adventure. Thirteen lectures. Seven zones. One final boss. Every lecture you finish earns stars, XP, and keeps your daily streak alive.
And every day begins with five fresh questions, picked from across the whole course. Small wins — every single day.
Each lecture opens with a two-minute quick check. Three questions, instant feedback — and the full set folds away until you're ready for it.
Concepts come alive inside the reading. Predict the answer first — then watch the DNS hierarchy climb, right where you're learning.
The OSI stack in true 3D. Drag it, spin it — and watch your data gain headers, layer by layer.
Even count-to-infinity — the most feared routing problem — becomes something you can watch, break, and fix with split horizon.
Every exam question from the course is here — all ninety-seven — with the answer key fully explained. And every coding problem solved in Java and C-plus-plus, with step-by-step visualisers.
Six arcade games turn subnetting, ports and headers into pure play.
It all leads to the final boss — a seventy-mark mock exam with its own health bar. Beat it, and the crown is yours.
NetMastery. Built for the exam. Designed to be loved. Star it on GitHub — and start your journey today.
